heroSummary: The first day of school for SAUSD students is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day of instruction is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Thanksgiving Recess runs November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027, and Spring Recess runs April 5–9, 2027.
calendarNotes: SAUSD’s official PDF separates elementary (ES), intermediate (IS), high school (HS), and Educational Options (OP) dates. The first and last days and major recesses are districtwide, while several student-free and modified days apply only to specific school levels.

sourceReviewSummary: This page follows the English 2026–27 calendar currently linked from SAUSD’s School Calendars page. The English calendar link on that page now points to a different PDF than the one previously cited here. The current file keeps the same first day, last day, major breaks, 180 student days, and 187 teacher duty days, but it revises the November day count and two grade-specific March modified-day dates.
sourceReviewDetails: On August 15, 2026, we followed the 2026–27 English calendar link on SAUSD’s School Calendars page and reviewed the PDF it currently resolves to.
We compared the current PDF with the previously linked file. The November instructional-day count changed from ES 13 / IS-HS-OP 14 to ES 14 / IS-HS-OP 15.
The current PDF lists March 19 as an elementary modified day and March 26 as an intermediate modified day. The prior PDF had those school levels reversed; this page now follows the current file.
We separately checked the ES, IS, HS, and OP notes for student-free days, parent conferences, modified days, Back to School Nights, and Open Houses.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SAUSD student-free days apply to elementary, intermediate, high school, or Educational Options students?
calendarFaqs.a: October 30 and February 19 are student-free for TK–12 except Educational Options; OP has modified days instead. Elementary students are also off November 16, intermediate students October 5, and OP students October 9, December 18, and March 5. High school students are also off December 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SAUSD students return after Winter Break?
Are February 12 and February 15 no-school days in SAUSD?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar lists Friday, February 12 and Monday, February 15 as separate holidays, creating a four-day weekend; it does not label them as one continuous break.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official SAUSD 2026–27 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Current SAUSD 2026–27 Academic School Calendar PDF in the Sources section or the View Official PDF button in Downloads. MySchoolDates also provides a separate one-time ICS import based on the dates reviewed for this page.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first day moves from August 11 in 2025–26 to August 10 in 2026–27.
The last day of instruction moves from May 28 to May 26.
Thanksgiving Recess shifts from November 24–28 in 2025–26 to November 23–27 in 2026–27.
Winter Break shifts from December 22–January 2 to December 21–January 1.
Spring Recess moves later in the calendar, from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to April 5–9 in 2026–27.
The totals remain 180 student instructional days and 187 teacher duty days.

customSections.label: Which SAUSD Student-Free Days Apply to My Child?
customSections.content: The official PDF uses ES for elementary, IS for intermediate, HS for high school, and OP for Educational Options. Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring Recess apply districtwide; the dates below do not all apply to every student.

groups.label: Elementary (ES)
items: Monday, November 16 is an elementary duty day and student-free day.
Elementary parent conferences run November 16–20 and March 8–12, with modified schedules.

groups.label: Intermediate (IS)
items: Monday, October 5 is an intermediate parent-conference duty day and student-free day.
Intermediate modified-day windows include December 16–18 and May 24–26.

groups.label: High school (HS)
items: Friday, December 18 is a high school duty day and student-free day.
High school modified-day windows include December 15–17 and May 24–26.

groups.label: Educational Options (OP)
items: OP student-free days are October 9, December 18, and March 5.
October 30 and February 19 are modified days for OP, not OP student-free days.

groups.label: TK–12 except OP
items: Friday, October 30 and Friday, February 19 are duty days and student-free days for TK–12 students except OP.

customSections.label: SAUSD Parent Conferences and Modified Days
customSections.content: Modified days shorten the regular schedule; dismissal times are set by the school. The PDF also states that Wednesdays are modified days for elementary and intermediate schools, Lorin Griset Academy, and Chavez High School.

groups.label: Back to School Night
items: Elementary: August 20, 2026; High school and Educational Options: August 27, 2026; Intermediate: September 3, 2026.

groups.label: Open House
items: Intermediate: March 18, 2027; Elementary: March 25, 2027; High school and Educational Options: April 1, 2027.
